Notes: Purpose of this standards file: define the rule set any AI agent built for an application must follow (system prompt design, tool design, model selection, input/output validation, conversation/memory management, observability, testing). Not tied to app type - a Web API, Database, or Class Library repo could each host agent code. Applies only once a repo actually implements a custom AI agent; until then it stays excluded via the repo's own copilot-instructions.md marker-exclusion table (agent.file).

Purpose of this standards file: define what a multi-agent team should look like for an application (team roles, communication protocol, handoff rules, failure handling, authorization/security, observability, testing). Same cross-cutting nature as GlobalAgentStandards - applies only once a repo implements a multi-agent system, independent of app type.
